resources.string: Raw device data; names and accounts are visible only here. Copy exports redacted results. Read/Refresh take a snapshot without syncing. Request Sync takes snapshots before and after a bounded 30-second wait. Activity ending does not prove a successful remote download. No event contents are read. The latest five snapshots and 200 trace entries stay in memory while this screen remains open. Opening or resuming DayRows only reads locally available provider data.
